title: Personal SLO Error-Budget Dashboard
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalslo:status
| stats latest(attained_pct) as attained, latest(target_pct) as target by objective
| eval error_budget=round(attained-target,1), breached=if(attained<target,1,0)
| sort error_budget
description: Treats your habits like service objectives — floss daily, sleep 7 hours, gym thrice weekly — with error budgets.
value: Framing habits as SLOs with a little slack is forgiving yet accountable, exactly why the technique works at work.
implementation: Define personal objectives in `index=personal`; track attainment against target and the remaining error budget.
visualization: Table of personal SLOs with attainment and error budget.
grandmaExplanation: It treats your goals like promises with a little wiggle room, showing which you are keeping and which are slipping.
